items.text: Fig2 plots the mean diastolic blood pressure against the mean ACE inhibition of the 9 healthy subjects without error bars, points connected in order of time (Results): kept as scatters of group volunteers, paired by row. The format 1 times 0-7 h are not in the paper and were removed. The 8 points per series were checked on an overlay of the calibrated figure; in the crowded cluster at 88-98 % two points are up to 4 px (about 1 %) from their marker centre.
items.author: mkoenig

items.text: Fig5 plots the mean urinary sodium excretion rate against the mean HCT excretion rate (group volunteers, no error bars): kept as scatters paired by row; 5 points per series checked on an overlay. x_time/y_time are not printed in Fig5: the curator matched each sodium value to the Fig4 series at the collection mid-points (0.5, 1.5, 3, 6, 16 h); supported by the Results (maximum HCT excretion rate 3.1 mg/h in the 1-2 h interval). The format 1 HCT excretion timecourses in the Fig4 sheet, which only repeated these Fig5 x values with the matched times, were commented out (not in Fig4). Confirm the time assignment or remove the times.
items.author: mkoenig

items.text: Fig1 corrected: the ACE inhibition series had been read on the left log concentration axis (for example 46.8 at 1 h, while the Results give 90 % after 1 h); the same pixel heights are now mapped to the right % inhibition axis (89.2 % at 1 h, 98.2 % peak). Late sample times set to 34, 46, 70 and 94 h from the isolated markers (Table 1: t1/2 24-94 h), were 36, 48, 72, 96 and one 38 h; the peak times set to 2 h (Results: peak levels and maximum inhibition at 2 h), were 2.6 and 3 h. Still uncertain: the 0-8 h region is crowded; the first points stand at time 0 although they are post-dose samples at about 0.5 h (48-50 % inhibition, 12.6 ng/ml), the cilazapril series lacks a point near 1 h (a filled triangle near 48 ng/ml is visible), and the concentration tails 22-94 h of both series are identical because the markers coincide. A new digitization of the 0-8 h region on the embedded figure of the PDF (819 x 715 px) is advised.
items.author: mkoenig

items.text: CIL2,5 renamed to CIL2.5 (no comma in names). Table 1 rows of the hypertensive patients had CIL5 and count 9; the footnote gives cilazapril 2.5 mg + HCT 25 mg, multiple dosing, and the Methods 16 patients once daily for 2 weeks: now CIL2.5 and the new HCTZ25md, both 14 daily doses with the last at 0 h, count 16. The sequence (2 weeks of one drug, then directly 2 weeks of the combination) means the combination regimen followed 2 weeks of monotherapy; this is not encoded. Form changed from tablet to NR (not reported).
